verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a data warehouse, so the axis applies. The evidence describes BigQuery only as a fully managed Google Cloud service with "no infrastructure to set up or manage" and shows no self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. Storing Iceberg data in customer-owned buckets, the open-source MCP Toolbox, and the community remark about moving to self-hosted OSS alternatives are adjacent or about other products, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
